title: WhyNoIPv6 — Geography & Networks
description: Where IPv6 is happening: country, ASN, DNS-provider, hosting, and TLD league tables. The advocacy dashboard — it names names.

panels.title: Apex IPv6 adoption by country
panels.description: Share of confirmed apex domains publishing AAAA, per attributed country (GeoIP + ccTLD attribution). Red = lagging, green = leading.

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.code, count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.base_status = 'supported')::float / nullif(count(d.base_status), 0) AS adoption FROM domain d JOIN country c ON c.id = d.country_id WHERE NOT d.disabled GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(d.base_status) >= 100

panels.title: Country league
panels.description: Per-country totals from the daily tick (country.sites / v6sites / percent). v6 = classification hero or partial.

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.code, c.name, c.sites AS domains, c.v6sites AS v6_domains, c.percent AS "v6 %" FROM country c WHERE c.sites >= 100 ORDER BY c.percent DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Country adoption over time (10 largest)
panels.description: base_supported share per day from stats_country_daily for the ten countries with the most tracked domains.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.day::timestamptz AS time, c.name AS metric, 100.0 * s.base_supported / nullif(s.domains, 0) AS pct FROM stats_country_daily s JOIN country c ON c.id = s.country_id WHERE $__timeFilter(s.day::timestamptz) AND s.country_id IN (SELECT country_id FROM stats_country_daily WHERE day = (SELECT max(day) FROM stats_country_daily) ORDER BY domains DESC LIMIT 10) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Most sinners by country (latest)
panels.description: Absolute confirmed-no-IPv6 counts from the latest daily snapshot — where the biggest piles of v4-only domains sit.

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.name AS country, s.sinners, s.domains, round(100.0 * s.sinners / nullif(s.domains, 0), 1) AS "sinner %" FROM stats_country_daily s JOIN country c ON c.id = s.country_id WHERE s.day = (SELECT max(day) FROM stats_country_daily) ORDER BY s.sinners DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: ASN league (≥100 domains)
panels.description: Per-network adoption from the daily tick. v6 = hero or partial. Sorted by size — scan the v6 % column for who is dragging the average.

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.number AS asn, a.name, a.count_total AS domains, a.count_v6 AS v6_domains, round(100.0 * a.count_v6 / nullif(a.count_total, 0), 1) AS "v6 %" FROM asn a WHERE a.count_total >= 100 ORDER BY a.count_total DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: DNS-provider league
panels.description: Domains per mapped DNS provider (nameserver-suffix mapping) and how many are v6 (hero|partial). Providers whose infrastructure gives customers IPv6 nameservers for free.

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.name AS provider, p.count_total AS domains, p.count_v6 AS v6_domains, round(100.0 * p.count_v6 / nullif(p.count_total, 0), 1) AS "v6 %" FROM dns_provider p WHERE p.count_total > 0 ORDER BY p.count_total DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Hosting / CDN breakdown
panels.description: The normalized hosting tag (CNAME-chain CDN detection + resolved-IP ASN). Shows which platforms carry the web — and whether being on them means having IPv6.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(hosting_provider, 'unattributed') AS hosting, count(*) AS domains, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE base_status = 'supported') / nullif(count(base_status), 0), 1) AS "apex v6 %", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE conn_status = 'supported') / nullif(count(conn_status), 0), 1) AS "reachable v6 %" FROM domain WHERE NOT disabled GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: TLD league (≥1000 domains)
panels.description: Apex AAAA adoption per public suffix. ccTLDs with registry-driven v6 incentives (.cz, .no, …) should stand out.

targets.rawSql: SELECT tld, count(*) AS domains, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE base_status = 'supported') / nullif(count(base_status), 0), 1) AS "apex v6 %" FROM domain WHERE NOT disabled AND tld IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) >= 1000 ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 30
